{{Top|ga}} {{Youmay|a battle at [[Malastare Narrows]]|the [[Clone Wars]]' [[Battle of Malastare]] or the [[Galactic Civil War]]'s [[Battle of Malastare (Galactic Civil War)|battle of Malastare]]|linebreak=1}} {{Battle |prev= |conc= |next=Eventually the [[Battle of Christophsis]]{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}} |image= |name=Battle of Malastare Narrows |conflict= |date=[[34 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' |place=[[Malastare Narrows]]{{BuildXWingCite|94|Starfighter Aces}} |result=[[Admiral]] [[Trench]] is presumed [[Death|dead]] |side1=*[[Galactic Republic]] *[[Jedi Order]] |side2=[[Corporate Alliance]]{{HelmetCollectionCite|78|Databank A-Z}} |side3= |side4= |commanders1=*[[Jedi Master]] [[Kep-She]]{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/cat-and-mouse-trivia-gallery|text="Cat and Mouse" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 2}} *[[Wullf Yularen]] |commanders2=Admiral Trench |commanders3= |commanders4= |unit1=*[[Republic Navy|Galactic Republic Navy]] *[[Kep-She's task force]] |unit2=[[Corporate fleet (Malastare)|Corporate fleet]] |unit3= |unit4= |forces1=*A Republic [[fleet]] **Several [[starship]]s |forces2=[[Trench's flagship]]† |forces3= |forces4= |casual1=*Significant **Most of Yularen's forces |casual2=Trench's [[flagship]] |casual3= |casual4= |civilian= }} {{Quote|If I remember my military history, wasn't he vaporized at the Battle of Malastare Narrows?|Anakin Skywalker, on Trench|audio=WasntHeVaporized-CatAndMouse.flac|}} The '''Battle of Malastare Narrows''' took place at [[Malastare Narrows]] in [[34 BBY]]. The [[Corporate Alliance]] [[Admiral]] [[Trench]] [[blockade]]d the [[planet]] [[Malastare]], and a [[Galactic Republic]] [[fleet]], in which the [[human]] [[Wullf Yularen]] served as one of the leading [[officer]]s, attacked Trench's [[Corporate fleet (Malastare)|forces]]. Trench repulsed them with ease, causing significant losses to the Republic. Ultimately, the issue was settled when a [[Kep-She's task force|task force]] [[Commanding officer|led]] by [[Jedi Master]] [[Kep-She]] destroyed [[Trench's flagship]] and supposedly [[Death|killed]] Trench. However, Trench survived the battle and later faced Yularen at the [[Battle of Christophsis]] in [[22 BBY]]. ==Prelude== {{Quote|A corporate fleet was blockading Malastare, a fleet led by Trench.|Wullf Yularen|audio=AFleetLedByTrench-CaM.flac|}} In [[34 BBY]], over a [[Standard decade|decade]] before the [[First Battle of Geonosis|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars]], a [[Corporate Alliance]] [[Corporate fleet (Malastare)|fleet]] [[Commanding officer|led]] by the [[Harch]] [[Admiral]] [[Trench]], the Alliance's best commander, formed a [[blockade]] around the [[planet]] [[Malastare]]. An attempt was made to resolve the situation [[diplomat]]ically but was unsuccessful. ==The battle== {{Quote|He tore our ships apart. We barely escaped with our lives. In the end, a Jedi-led task force moved in to settle the matter. Trench's ship was destroyed and we assumed he went down with it.''"
"''Are you sure it's him?''"
"''It's possible. Not every captain goes down with his ship.|Wullf Yularen and Anakin Skywalker|audio=HeToreOurShipsApart-CaM.flac|}} [[File:AdmiralTrenchofChristophsis-TotOR2023.png|thumb|left|200px|Admiral Trench led the Corporate fleet during the battle.]] A [[Republic Navy|naval]] [[fleet]] of [[Galactic Republic]] [[starship]]s, in which the [[human]] [[Wullf Yularen]] served as one of the leading [[officer]]s, attacked Trench's fleet at [[Malastare Narrows]] on several occasions. Trench pushed the Republic back multiple [[time]]s and inflicted significant losses before claiming victory''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' with contemptuous ease, destroying most of Yularen's forces and thus becoming a recognized [[Navy|naval]] officer. Eventually, the matter was resolved when a [[Kep-She's task force|task force]] led by [[Jedi Master]] [[Kep-She]] moved in on the Corporate fleet. The [[Jedi Order|Jedi]]-led [[task force]] destroyed [[Trench's flagship]], with the admiral being presumed [[Death|dead]], and restored peace to Malastare. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|The last time I saw that symbol, well, let's just say I lost a lot of good men that day.|Wullf Yularen, on Trench's unmistakable insignia|audio=LostALotOfGoodMen-CaM.flac|}} In the battle's aftermath, Yularen left the navy and joined the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence]], with his [[Dream|nightmares]] being haunted by Trench, the individual most akin to a nemesis for Yularen. However, Trench revealed that he had survived the battle when he led the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Christophsis blockade|blockade]] at the [[Battle of Christophsis]] during the Clone Wars in [[22 BBY]], where he again fought against Yularen. During the Battle of Christophsis, [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] recalled Trench's supposed death at the battle, and Yularen relayed his experience of the battle to Skywalker. ==Behind the scenes== The Battle of Malastare Narrows was first mentioned in "[[Cat and Mouse]]," the sixteenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which aired on [[March 26]], [[2010]].{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode216.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cat and Mouse}} The [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 78|seventy-eighth issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[Star Wars Helmet Collection]]'' magazine, published around [[July 12]], [[2016]],{{HelmetDatesFR|78}} and written by [[Iain Lowson]],{{EmailCite|email=File:HCSV-Email-2025-07-26.png|author=[[Iain Lowson]]|date=2025-07-26}} alternatively identified the battle as the Battle of the Malastare Narrows. ==Appearances==
